name: MonarchRegionSelect
title: RegionSelect
wrapsNative: MonarchCombobox (androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox with a menu or androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet), or MonarchTextField (androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField with ContentType.AddressRegion) for a country without a list
summary: A picker of a first-level subdivision of a country (state, province, territory or nation) from the app's list, a loader or a built-in list, with a text field for countries without one.
whenToUse: Next to a country field in an address, tax or shipping form, when the region should be a code from a list where one exists.
whenNotToUse: For the country itself use MonarchCountrySelect; for a free-text region in every country use MonarchTextField; for a whole address with suggestions use MonarchAddressAutocomplete.
api: @Composable fun MonarchRegionSelect(country: String?, selected: String?, onSelectedChange: (String?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, regions: List<MonarchRegionSelectRegion>? = null, loadRegions: (suspend (country: String) -> List<MonarchRegionSelectRegion>)? = null, presentation: MonarchComboboxPresentation = MonarchComboboxPresentation.Automatic, enabled: Boolean = true, allowTextEntry: Boolean = true, showCode: Boolean = false, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, clearOptionLabel: String? = null, clearIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchRegionSelectLabels = MonarchRegionSelectLabels())

class MonarchRegionSelectLabels(label: String? = null, chooseCountryFirst: String? = null, textEntry: String? = null, empty: String? = null, loadFailed: String? = null, combobox: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels())

options.name: country
options.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country whose regions are listed, in any case, or null to disable the field.

options.name: selected
options.description: The chosen region code, or the typed text when the country has no list, or null.

options.name: onSelectedChange
options.description: Called with the chosen code or the typed text, or null when cleared or emptied.

options.name: regions
options.description: The country's regions from the app's own data. Wins over loadRegions and the built-in lists.

options.name: loadRegions
options.description: Loads a country's regions. Called once per country and kept for the life of the field; throw to show the retry message; an empty list gives the text field. Wins over the built-in lists.

options.name: presentation
options.description: Menu, Sheet, or Automatic: a menu for up to eight regions, a sheet otherwise.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the field can be used.

options.name: allowTextEntry
options.description: Shows a text field when the country has no list; otherwise the combobox stays, with no options.

options.name: showCode
options.description: Shows the region code without its country prefix ("CA" for "US-CA") at the end of each row.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown in the empty field while nothing is chosen. The text field's default is "Type the region".

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error message; replaces the helper text and is set as the field's error.

options.name: clearOptionLabel
options.description: Adds a first row that clears the selection.

options.name: clearIcon
options.description: The icon of a clear button at the end of the field while a region is chosen.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: the label (by default the country's own word), "Choose a country first", "Type the region", "No regions match", "Couldn’t load the regions." and the combobox's own strings.

states.name: no country
states.description: The field is disabled and the text under it says "Choose a country first" (unless helperText is given).

states.name: list
states.description: The combobox lists the regions; the label is the country's word for them ("State", "Province or territory").

states.name: loading
states.description: While loadRegions runs the list says "Loading…" and the sheet's search field shows its pending state.

states.name: load failed
states.description: MonarchInlineErrorRetry under the field says "Couldn’t load the regions." with Try again, which asks the loader again.

states.name: text entry
states.description: A country without a list gets a MonarchTextField with "Type the region" as its placeholder.

states.name: error
states.description: The field has the danger outline and the message below it.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The field takes the disabled colors and does not open or edit.

appearance: The combobox and the text field use MonarchTextField's colors: a surface fill with the input border, the danger strong color in error. The list is on the surface color with muted second lines and the accent strong radio mark; the retry message uses MonarchInlineErrorRetry's danger roles. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Built on MonarchCombobox and MonarchTextField. The built-in lists are the web component's (Monarch, MIT): the United States with DC, Canada, Australia, the United Kingdom's nations and India, with English names and ISO 3166-2 codes, which are public. loadRegions is a suspending function cancelled by Compose when the field leaves, instead of the web's AbortSignal; a failed load shows MonarchInlineErrorRetry under the field rather than inside the list. The text field sets the autofill content type AddressRegion. The value is controlled only. iOS has no RegionSelect yet; the name is the planned shared one.
accessibility: The combobox is MonarchCombobox's exposed dropdown anchor: TalkBack reads the label, the chosen region and the expand state; rows are radio buttons at least 48dp high, the chosen one selected.
Without a country the field is disabled and the text under it, read with the field, says why.
The text field is a standard text field named by its label, with the address region autofill type.
The load failure is MonarchInlineErrorRetry, a message with a Try again button at least 48dp high.
The error is the field's error semantics and is shown as text.
edgeCases: Changing the country starts a fresh list and search; the app should clear selected, as a region code belongs to one country.
A selected code that is not in the list shows an empty field.
Region names in the built-in lists are English in every locale; pass regions for localised names.
With allowTextEntry false a country without a list shows an empty combobox that says "No regions match".

examples.title: With CountrySelect and built-in lists
examples.setupTemplate:
var country by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>({{country.value}}) }
var region by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>({{region.value}}) }
examples.setup:
var country by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>("US") }
var region by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

examples.title: The app's own regions
examples.code:
MonarchRegionSelect(
    country = "PT",
    selected = district,
    onSelectedChange = { district = it },
    regions = listOf(
        MonarchRegionSelectRegion("PT-11", "Lisboa"),
        MonarchRegionSelectRegion("PT-13", "Porto"),
    ),
)
